body.statement: On the fixed-rank spectral-gap stratum, form \(\widehat R=\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B\widehat W\) and \(\widehat N=I_{K^{2}}-\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B(\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B)^{+}\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\) from the same fitted factorization. Then \(\|\widehat N-N_B\|_{\mathrm{op}}\leq C_{\mathrm{reg}}(r_D+r_B)\), \(r_R+r_N+r_h+r_G+r_b=O_P(R_{\Sigma})\), and the estimated correction is linearly stable: \(\|\widehat Q\widehat U-QU\|_{L^{2}(P)}\leq C_{\mathrm{reg}}R_{\Sigma}\); the full estimated efficient score has the same \(L^{2}(P)\) bound.
body.justification: Pseudoinverse perturbation control is needed to transport nuisance rates into score convergence without differentiating the outcome-density estimator twice.
body.gap: The adjacent bridge papers do not analyze perturbation of this nested posterior and conditional-Gram projector.
body.consumer: It converts rates from a coherent latent-factor fit into consistent standard errors and stable contrast scores.
